"""Targeted edge cases: empty FIBs, /0 rules, hand-built images, transport quirks."""
import json, subprocess, time, importlib.util, importlib.machinery
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader('sub', importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('sub', '/app/submit/run'))
sub = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sub)

def run_lines(lines, timeout=200):
    data = b''
    for x in lines:
        data += (x.encode() if isinstance(x, str) else x) + b'\n'
    t = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=timeout)
    dt = time.time() - t
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr[-2000:]
    out = [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
    assert len(out) == len(lines), (len(out), len(lines))
    return out, dt

# --- empty FIB compile: exact image ---
req = {"op": "compile", "fib": [], "capacities": [4096]*4, "max_stride": 32}
r = sub.handle_compile(req)
assert r['status'] == 'ok'
assert r['used_bits'] == [128, 0, 0, 0], r['used_bits']
assert r['peak'] == {'num': 1, 'den': 32}, r['peak']
assert r['stages'][0] == {'nodes': [{'prefix': '::/0', 'rules': [], 'edges': []}]}
for st in r['stages'][1:]:
    assert st == {'nodes': []}
print('empty FIB image ok:', json.dumps(r['stages'][0]))

# --- /0-only FIB ---
req = {"op": "compile", "fib": [{"prefix": "::/0", "hop": 0}], "capacities": [4096]*4, "max_stride": 32}
r = sub.handle_compile(req)
assert r['used_bits'] == [192, 0, 0, 0], r['used_bits']
assert r['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['rules'] == [{'prefix': '::/0', 'hop': 0}]
assert r['peak'] == {'num': 3, 'den': 64}
# lookup on it: everything matches /0 with hop 0
lr = sub.handle_lookup({"op": "lookup", "image": r, "addresses": ["::1", "ffff::1"]})
assert lr == {'status': 'ok', 'answers': [{'hop': 0, 'prefix_length': 0}, {'hop': 0, 'prefix_length': 0}]}, lr
print('/0-only FIB ok')

# --- empty-FIB image lookup: no matches anywhere ---
lr = sub.handle_lookup({"op": "lookup", "image": r if False else sub.handle_compile({"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[4096]*4,"max_stride":32}), "addresses": ["::1"]})
assert lr == {'status': 'ok', 'answers': [{'hop': None, 'prefix_length': None}]}, lr
print('empty-FIB lookup ok')

# --- hand-built image with non-optimal cuts must validate ---
fib = [(0x20010db8000000000000000000000000, 32, 8), (0x20010db8000000000000000000000001, 128, 9)]
for cuts in ([0, 1, 2, 3, 128], [0, 32, 33, 100, 128], [0, 127, 128 - 0, 128, 128] if False else [0, 126, 127, 128 - 0, 128] if False else [0, 64, 65, 66, 128]):
    caps = [1000000000]*4
    stages, used, raw = sub.build_layout(fib, cuts)
    num, den = sub.peak_fraction(used, caps)
    img = {'status': 'ok', 'capacities': caps, 'max_stride': 64 if False else 64,
           'cuts': cuts, 'stages': stages, 'used_bits': used, 'peak': {'num': num, 'den': den}}
    img['max_stride'] = 128  # invalid stride
    try:
        sub.validate_image(img)
        raise AssertionError('stride 128 must be invalid')
    except sub.Invalid:
        pass
    img['max_stride'] = max(cuts[i+1]-cuts[i] for i in range(4))
    c2, r2 = sub.validate_image(img)
    lut = sub.build_lut(r2, c2)
    print('hand-built cuts', cuts, 'validated, used', used)
print('hand-built image validation ok')

        '\t {"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[4096,4096,4096,4096],"max_stride":32} \t',
        '{"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[4096,4096,4096,4096],"max_stride":32}']
res, dt = run_lines(reqs)
assert all(x['status'] == 'ok' for x in res), res
print('CRLF/whitespace lines ok')

# whitespace-padded large valid request (exercises the pre-screen guard)
pad = ' ' * 3000000
big = '{"op":"compile",' + pad + '"fib":[{"prefix":"::/0","hop":1}],"capacities":[4096,4096,4096,4096],"max_stride":32}'
res, dt = run_lines([big])
assert res[0]['status'] == 'ok', res[0]
print('3MB whitespace-padded valid request ok (%.2fs)' % dt)

# huge valid request with unicode escapes

print('escaped-prefix request ok')

# 32MB hostile line: must be rejected fast and not break the next request
hostile = '{"op":"compile","fib":[' + '1,' * 15000000 + '1],"capacities":[4096]*4,"max_stride":32}'
assert len(hostile) > 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 100

                  "capacities": [4096]*4, "max_stride": 32})

assert res[1]['status'] == 'ok', res[1]
print('32MB hostile line rejected in %.2fs; next request ok' % dt)

assert res[0] == {'status': 'invalid'}, res[0]

print('deep-nesting hostile line rejected in %.2fs' % dt)

# 32MB line that is one giant string (valid JSON, invalid request)

assert res[1]['status'] == 'ok'

                          "fib": [{"prefix": "%x/%d" % ((i << 100) | (i << 50), 128), "hop": i} for i in range(1500)],
                          "capacities": [1000000000]*8, "max_stride": 16})
s = json.dumps({"op": "lookup", "image": img, "addresses": ["2001:db8::1"] * 100})
assert len(s) > 1000000
res, dt = run_lines([s])
assert res[0]['status'] == 'ok', res[0]
print('%.1fMB valid lookup request ok (%.2fs)' % (len(s)/1e6, dt))
print('ALL EDGE CASE TESTS PASSED')
